[[Pastoria City]] }} '''Besting Buizel II''' (Japanese: '''VS ブイゼルII''' ''VS Buizel II''), titled '''VS Buizel II''' in the [[Chuang Yi]] translation, is the 402nd chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 65th chapter of the {{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}. It is subtitled '''Cyrus and the Perfect World''' (Japanese: '''アカギと完全な世界''' ''Akagi and Perfect World'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Cyrus and a Perfect World''' in the Chuang Yi translation. ==Plot== {{spoilers}} As [[Crasher Wake]]'s Pokémon summon rain over [[Lake Valor]] and {{rt|213|Sinnoh}}, {{adv|Pearl}} continues trying to catch a {{p|Buizel}}. Under Wake's guidance, Pearl finally manages to capture one in a [[Poké Ball]]. He is reminded of [[Paka and Uji|Uji]], who also had a Buizel, and realizes that having the same Pokémon as {{adv|Platinum}}'s former bodyguards may lead him to become as strong as them. Pearl chooses "Zeller" as a nickname for his new Buizel. Zeller's Poké Ball suddenly springs out of Pearl's hands and rolls away from him. Crasher Wake picks it up, noting that Pearl needs to train Zeller in order for it to listen to him. Pearl is ready to start training, but Wake explains that having four Pokémon may not be enough to face [[Team Galactic]]. He tells Pearl that he will need to catch two more Pokémon before the end of the night. Already exhausted, Pearl is nervous, but Wake laughs it off and steers him to {{rt|212|Sinnoh}}. Meanwhile, at [[Veilstone City]], the three airships—each carrying one of the {{adv|lake guardians}}—arrive at the [[Team Galactic HQ]]. [[Mars]], [[Saturn]], and [[Jupiter]] meet with [[Cyrus]], who commends them for their work. After ordering them to gather every {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}} in the room, he begins to deliver a speech. To the members of Team Galactic, Cyrus declares that the world is imperfect, and that they will be the ones to change it with the power of the lake guardians. As the sun begins to rise over Route 212, Pearl finally catches two other Pokémon for his team. He thanks Crasher Wake and [[Rad Rickshaw]] as he prepares to leave. Before he goes, Wake offers to get Pearl a present for when he succeeds in stopping Team Galactic. Pearl asks for a theme song, just like Wake's. As Wake begins to laugh, Pearl spots a {{p|Rapidash}}-drawn carriage approaching them. [[Johanna]], {{adv|Sebastian}}, [[Roseanne]], and [[Fantina's Drifblim]] depart the carriage and head toward Pearl. Drifblim gives him [[Tru]] and [[Kit]]'s Poké Balls, and Pearl becomes scared that something has happened to {{adv|Diamond}}. Johanna reveals that Diamond is inside of a Team Galactic airship, shocking Pearl. ==Major events== * {{adv|Pearl}} captures a {{p|Buizel}} along with two other unspecified Pokémon. * {{adv|Sebastian}}, [[Johanna]], and [[Roseanne]] catch up with Pearl and tell him {{adv|Diamond}} is in the Team Galactic airship. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Diamond}} (flashback) * {{adv|Pearl}} * [[Crasher Wake]] * [[Cyrus]] * [[Mars]] * [[Jupiter]] * [[Saturn]] * [[Paka and Uji]] (flashback) * [[Johanna]] * [[Rad Rickshaw]] * {{adv|Sebastian}} * [[Roseanne]] * {{tc|Team Galactic Grunt}}s ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Torterra}} ([[Tru]]/{{tt|Wig|Chuang Yi}};
